mapper.sql: FROM bbs_post p INNER JOIN bbs_folder f ON f.folder_idx = p.folder_idx LEFT JOIN store_mst sm ON sm.store_idx = p.store_idx LEFT JOIN user_mst um ON um.user_id = p.created_by
mapper.select:
SELECT p.post_idx, p.folder_idx, f.folder_nm, p.store_idx, sm.store_nm, p.title, CAST(p.private_yn AS VARCHAR) AS private_yn, CAST(p.notice_yn AS VARCHAR) AS notice_yn, p.view_cnt, p.created_by, COALESCE(um.user_name, p.created_by, '') AS author_nm, p.created_at, p.updated_at, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bbs_doc d WHERE d.post_idx = p.post_idx AND d.deleted_yn = false ) AS has_attachment, ( SELECT d.content_type FROM bbs_doc d WHERE d.post_idx = p.post_idx AND d.deleted_yn = false AND ( COALESCE(d.content_type, '') ILIKE 'image/%' OR lower(d.file_name) ~ '\.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|bmp|webp)$' ) ORDER BY d.bbs_doc_idx LIMIT 1 ) AS thumb_content_type, ( SELECT d.bbs_doc_idx FROM bbs_doc d WHERE d.post_idx = p.post_idx AND d.deleted_yn = false AND ( COALESCE(d.content_type, '') ILIKE 'image/%' OR lower(d.file_name) ~ '\.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|bmp|webp)$' ) ORDER BY d.bbs_doc_idx LIMIT 1 ) AS thumb_doc_idx
WHERE AND
AND p.folder_idx = #{folderIdx}
AND ( p.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(p.body_txt, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(um.user_name, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(CAST(p.notice_yn AS VARCHAR), 'N') = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.post_idx, p.folder_idx, f.folder_nm, p.store_idx, sm.store_nm, p.title, p.body_txt, CAST(p.private_yn AS VARCHAR) AS private_yn, CAST(p.notice_yn AS VARCHAR) AS notice_yn, p.view_cnt, p.created_by, COALESCE(um.user_name, p.created_by, '') AS author_nm, p.created_at, p.updated_at, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bbs_doc d WHERE d.post_idx = p.post_idx AND d.deleted_yn = false ) AS has_attachment
WHERE p.post_idx = #{postIdx} AND p.deleted_yn = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs_post ( folder_idx, store_idx, title, body_txt, private_yn, notice_yn, created_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{folderIdx}, #{storeIdx}, TRIM(#{title}), #{bodyTxt}, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{privateYn}), ''), 'N'), COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{noticeYn}), ''), 'N'), #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE bbs_post SET folder_idx = #{body.folderIdx}, store_idx = #{storeIdx}, title = TRIM(#{body.title}), body_txt = #{body.bodyTxt}, private_yn = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{body.privateYn}), ''), private_yn), notice_yn = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{body.noticeYn}), ''), notice_yn), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE post_idx = #{postIdx} AND deleted_yn = false
UPDATE bbs_post SET deleted_yn = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE post_idx = #{postIdx}
UPDATE bbs_post SET view_cnt = view_cnt + 1 WHERE post_idx = #{postIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bbs_post WHERE folder_idx = #{folderIdx} AND deleted_yn = false
